description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultPubSubConfig class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies immutability, equality/hashCode methods, and configuration value parsing with different config sources.

classes.name: DefaultPubSubConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultPubSubConfig, testing default values, configuration parsing, and immutability.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Loads the configuration file 'pubsub-test.conf' before running tests.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that DefaultPubSubConfig instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations for DefaultPubSubConfig.

methods.name: underTestReturnsDefaultValuesIfBaseConfigWasEmpty
methods.description: Validates that DefaultPubSubConfig returns correct default values when initialized with an empty configuration.

methods.name: underTestReturnsValuesOfConfigFile
methods.description: Validates that DefaultPubSubConfig correctly reads values from the provided configuration file.
